requirement_description: All students on exchange must have comprehensive travel insurance covering medical emergencies and repatriation
notes: Minimum coverage: SGD 50000 medical; SGD 100000 repatriation

requirement_description: Students are recommended to use full-service carriers for long-haul international flights
notes: Budget airlines acceptable for short regional flights under 4 hours

requirement_description: Students must check Singapore MFA travel advisories before booking
notes: Do not travel to destinations with Level 3 or 4 advisories

requirement_description: Book flights at least 8-10 weeks before departure for better rates
notes: Last-minute bookings may exceed budget guidelines

requirement_description: Passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond return date
notes: Some destinations require longer validity periods

requirement_description: Students may book on Trip.com, NTU's travel partner, or use other travel agents for assistance
notes: Prototype: Trip.com added as NTU travel partner. Earlier list: CWT Singapore; BCD Travel; Flight Centre

requirement_description: Register emergency contact details with NTU before departure
Budget airlines acceptable for flights under 4 hours within Asia-Pacific
notes: Examples: Scoot; Jetstar acceptable for regional travel

requirement_description: Begin visa application process minimum 12 weeks before departure
Book accommodation through university or verified platforms

policy_name: Full-Service Carriers for Funded Staff Travel
requirement_description: NTU-funded staff and faculty trips must use full-service carriers; budget airline fares are not reimbursed

policy_name: Trip.com as Booking Partner for Funded Staff Travel
requirement_description: NTU-funded staff trips must be booked on Trip.com, NTU's travel partner under its Trip.com subscription, so they can be claimed
notes: Prototype: replaces the earlier approved-agent list (CWT Singapore; BCD Travel; Flight Centre). Past staff trips in staff_trips.csv were booked before the Trip.com partnership

policy_name: Hotel Limit per Night for Staff Travel
requirement_description: Hotel costs are reimbursed up to the nightly limit for the destination city; staff pay any amount above it
exemption_process: Head of department approval for exceptions
notes: Limits by city are in staff_claim_limits.csv

requirement_description: Staff receive a fixed daily allowance for meals and local transport for each travel day (nights + 1)
notes: Rates by city are in staff_claim_limits.csv
